name: listbox

description: Presents an always-visible option list with roving focus, typeahead, groups, and single or multi-range selection.

import '@ui-sdk/web/listbox'
import './listbox.css'

export {
  createListboxController,
} from '@ui-sdk/web/listbox'
export type ListboxSurface = 'base' | 'layer-1'
export type ListboxItemProps<T = string> = Omit<
  BaseListboxItemProps,
  'value' | 'class' | 'render'
> & {
  value: T
  class?: BaseListboxItemProps['class']
  render?: BaseListboxItemProps['render']
}
